title: MeYouSocial Publisher in two minutes
message: One loop from research to results, mostly on its own — your job is decisions, not production
audience: Companies without a content team, agencies, creators, teams that need control

scenes.headline: A machine, with a person at the *gates.*
scenes.narration: Most content tools hand you a blank page and a calendar. MeYouSocial Publisher hands you a machine, with a person at the gates.
scenes.spoken: Most content tools hand you a blank page and a calendar. Me You Social Publisher hands you a machine, with a person at the gates.

scenes.headline: Whatever it can't fix waits for *you.*
scenes.narration: Every thirty minutes a sweep runs. It discovers ideas, drafts the ones you approved, gives each article its images and SEO, sources every claim, and advances what passes. Whatever it cannot fix waits here, in your Inbox, with the action on the card.
scenes.spoken: Every thirty minutes a sweep runs. It discovers ideas, drafts the ones you approved, gives each article its images and S E O, sources every claim, and advances what passes. Whatever it cannot fix waits here, in your Inbox, with the action on the card.

callouts.text: The action is on the card.

scenes.headline: One loop, from research to *results.*
scenes.narration: The whole interface is one loop. Research, Ideas, Drafts, Review, Publish, Distribute, Measure. The Inbox above it shows exactly what is waiting on you. Setup beneath it holds the dials.

callouts.label: Above the loop
callouts.title: Inbox — what is waiting on you

scenes.headline: Only approved ideas are *drafted.*
scenes.narration: Ideas hang off your Topics, on one board for articles, social posts and video. The engine discovers them. You approve them. Only approved ideas are drafted, and approving is your act.

callouts.label: Formats
callouts.title: Article · Social · Video
callouts.note: one board, three formats, Topics as the lanes

scenes.headline: Every gate, *visible.*
scenes.narration: Drafts arrive grounded in your brand and your experts, with a focus keyword, meta title, description and slug filled in, a featured image, a branded social preview, and a checklist that shows every gate and whether it passes.

callouts.label: Per article
callouts.title: Focus keyword · meta title · description · slug
callouts.note: Metadata you write by hand is never overwritten

callouts.label: Images
callouts.title: Featured + 1200×630 social preview
callouts.note: AI images land as pending for review

scenes.headline: Gates review as well as *block.*
scenes.narration: Review is what still needs a person. A claim with no source: verify it with a link, or drop it. An image that needs your eye. A question only you can answer, asked once and banked to the expert profile. Every clearing act moves the article at once.

callouts.label: Asked once
callouts.title: Your answer is banked to the expert profile

callouts.text: Every clearing act moves the article at once.

scenes.headline: Fifteen networks, one *connection.*
scenes.narration: Publish sends the article to your website on your publish day, or right now with one click. Distribute fans one post out to fifteen networks through a single connection, on posting slots you set once, in your own timezone.

scenes.headline: Never an invented *number.*
scenes.narration: And Measure pulls the results back in. Search impressions and clicks, traffic, engagement by network, and the best time to post. Measured numbers only. A dash means not measured. Never zero, and never a guess.

callouts.text: A dash means not measured, never zero.
